## What we agreed

- Priority order: silent propagation > flagged > action switch > same.
- `other` is for unparseable, refusal, or outside-taxonomy responses.
- Low confidence plus a note is better than a silent guess.
- No discussion of individual labels before both raters submit.
- No arm labels or perturbation records during a blind audit.
